simple.meaning: יִשְׂרָאֵל (Yisrâʼêl) appears 2507 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into conflict.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 32:29. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, altar, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִשְׂרָאֵל (H3478) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יִשְׂרָאֵל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
